requirements_summary: Customer: ResolveAI Concierge (support SaaS) building customer support virtual agent + ticket deflection pipeline. Index scale ~12 million documents (KB articles + support history). Latency SLOs: end-to-end query P95 < 200ms for deflection flow; reranker budget ~30-60ms P95 (goal 40ms). Throughput baseline 200 qps with 600 qps expected peaks during business-hours spikes. Quality targets: top-5 precision/recall high enough to drive deflection >60% and agent recall improvements; internal metric: MRR@5 target >= 0.80. Cost sensitivity: target cost/query (embeddings + ANN + rerank) <= $0.006-0.01. Prefer dense retrieval + ANN candidate gen, GPU-accelerated embedding service, and quantized cross-encoder reranker for top-5 re-score. Data residency US-East, ingestion pipeline must preserve PII redaction steps. Wants canary routing and fallback to smaller models during overload.
